faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DLSA Sri Ganganagar Para Legal Volunteer recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application form for the DLSA Sri Ganganagar Para Legal Volunteer (Rights Friend) posts is 17 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Para Legal Volunteer post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 29 vacancies for the Para Legal Volunteer (Rights Friend) position announced by the District Legal Services Authority Sri Ganganagar.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed Senior Secondary (Class 12) from the Rajasthan Board or an equivalent examination and possess good knowledge of Hindi in the Devanagari script.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Para Legal Volunteer role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be paid a stipend of Rs. 750 per day for the Para Legal Volunteer (Rights Friend) position.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the DLSA Sri Ganganagar Para Legal Volunteer recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the form and submit it via post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Para Legal Volunteer (Rights Friend) posts will involve an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category of candidates applying for the DLSA Sri Ganganagar Para Legal Volunteer recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is PV/2026/01.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for the Para Legal Volunteer position?
faq.answer: The Para Legal Volunteer (Rights Friend) position is on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the DLSA Sri Ganganagar located?
faq.answer: The District Legal Services Authority Sri Ganganagar is located in Sri Ganganagar, Rajasthan.
